  • Method Details

    • placeOrder

      public long placeOrder(long storeId, long cashierId, List<CartItem> lines, double total, double tip) throws SQLException
      Inserts an order and all of its lines in one transaction. The order is saved with status completed and the current time. If any insert fails, nothing is saved.
      Parameters:
      storeId - store the order was placed at
      cashierId - employee who rang up the order
      lines - cart lines; each line's unit price is taken from its Item as loaded in the cart, not re-read from the database. A null special request means default (100% sweet, regular ice).
      total - order total as calculated by the caller, rounded to the cent before saving; not checked against lines
      tip - tip amount, rounded to the cent before saving
      Returns:
      the new order's id
      Throws:
      SQLException - if any insert fails; the transaction is rolled back first
